gate.description: WIRED_LIVE: kernel_symbol is declared in kernel_file and referenced by at least one non-test live_consumers file. KERNEL_ONLY: declared in kernel_file but not referenced by any live consumer. MISSING: kernel_symbol (or kernel_file) does not exist yet; entries marked status=planned are acknowledged gaps.

features.description: Vanilla F3+A debug chord: Reload all loaded chunks.
Vanilla F3+B debug chord: Toggle the entity_hitboxes debug renderer (gated by reduced_debug_info).
Vanilla F3+C debug chord: Copy player location as a /execute in <dim> run tp @s <pos> <rot> command; hold 10s for the manual debug crash.
Vanilla F3+D debug chord: Clear chat history while keeping typed lines accessible via up/down.
Vanilla F3+F4 debug chord: Open the game-mode switcher overlay (operator permission required).
Vanilla F3+G debug chord: Toggle the chunk_borders debug renderer.
Vanilla F3+H debug chord: Toggle advanced item tooltips (registry ids, durability, enchantments).
Vanilla F3+I debug chord: Copy the looked-at block/entity data as a command (Shift copies client data).
Vanilla F3+N debug chord: Cycle between spectator mode and the previous game mode.
Vanilla F3+P debug chord: Toggle pause-when-unfocused (auto-pause) option.
Vanilla F3+Q debug chord: Show the debug hotkey help overlay listing all F3 chords.
Vanilla F3+T debug chord: Reload resource packs (textures, models, sounds).
Vanilla F3+1 debug chord: Toggle the profiler pie chart on the debug screen.
Vanilla F3+2 debug chord: Toggle the FPS/TPS frame-time graph on the debug screen.
Vanilla F3+3 debug chord: Toggle the bandwidth/ping network charts on the debug screen.
